The charge likely "故意伤害" (intentional injury) leading to death? However the facts: they attacked victim after provocation, used knives, causing death. That is intentional homicide. The list includes "故意伤害" but not "故意杀人". The list only has "故意伤害". The scenario: they fought with victim, used weapons, resulting in death. Could be "故意伤害" and "聚众斗殴". However "聚众斗殴" is for group fighting causing disorder. The facts: they were a group of five, they attacked victim. Could be considered "聚众斗殴". The list also includes "抢劫", "抢夺", etc. Not relevant.

The list includes "聚众扰乱社会秩序" and "聚众扰乱公共场所秩序、交通秩序". Not exactly. "聚众斗殴" is present. So we can include both.

Thus final answer: [罪名]故意伤害;聚众斗殴<eoa>
